fixture.notes: Short paraphrase for classification, not a complete cooking recipe. Uses the main machine-assisted method; the source also offers manual alternatives. Title adjectives are controlled experimental interventions, not four independent recipes.

recipe.title: Traditional Ravioli
instructions: Process the dough ingredients, knead briefly, and allow at least a half-hour rest.
Combine the cheese filling. Roll thin sheets with a pasta machine, portion filling, seal and cut.
Boil the filled pasta for 6–8 minutes. Uncooked portions may be frozen for later meals.

fixture.expected_label_status: Proposed evaluation rubric, not human-verified training labels

limitations: One recipe and four titles cannot establish general shortcut robustness. Invalid responses are excluded from flip-rate denominators and counted separately. Hosted and local models differ; provider differences are not an isolated model-quality experiment.
